opponent.label: Toadette
opponent.description: The cheerful girl from the Mushroom Kingdom has grown up and is ready to experience the adult games at the Inventory. When she’s not out collecting gold on some adventure, she’s busy challenging anyone who thinks they stand a chance. Whether it’s a fast kart race, a poker tournament, or any other game, she’s fiercely competitive and won’t lose easily. Don’t expect her to go easy on you, but you can trust her to play fair. She despises cheaters and only truly enjoys a victory when it’s earned.
